headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of August 7, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 26.39% compared to SPY's 14.11%. This results in an average alpha of 12.28%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a remarkable return of 45.86%, significantly contributing to the overall outperformance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 15.55%, which is still above the benchmark but less impactful. This relative strength is particularly notable during periods of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience against broader market movements. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
